label: GO after an unrewarded a2 -> S2 (common) trial
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1/D2). Strong activations (top half, ~0.7-1.0 of max) come at GO right after the previous trial chose a2, reached S2 by a common transition, and went unrewarded (on the window first trial the previous choice is unknown, so those cases are included). The strict version (prev a2, prev S2, prev unrewarded) has precision 0.83 and 75% of mass; the recorded version, which also lets in the first-trial GO, covers 91% of activation mass and 87-100% of the top two activation quartiles. Recall by count is only ~0.53 because of a long tail of weak activations (~0.03-0.15 of max) at GO steps where the agent chooses a2 after rewarded trials, often within runs of a2 choices; it almost never fires when the previous choice was a1 or the previous trial was rewarded at high magnitude. Firing is associated with the model choosing a2 (choice logit strongly negative, model_act a2 in 91% of mass) and is more frequent in mid-episode (trials 20-69). Uses only observed variables.
